title: Why everyone from OpenAI to SpaceX is building their own chips (and turning up the heat on Nvidia)
brief: OpenAI is developing Jalapeño, a custom inference chip with Broadcom, as part of a broader industry trend where major tech companies including Google, Apple, and SpaceX are building proprietary chips to reduce dependence on Nvidia. This shift reflects growing concerns about single-supplier risk and the potential for greater competition in the AI chip market.
